text:
Which action will demagnetise a magnetised piece of steel?
A
Cool it in a freezer for several hours.
B
Hit it repeatedly with a hammer.
C
Put it in a coil carrying a direct current (d.c.).
D
Put it near an unmagnetised piece of iron.

options.label: A
options.text: Cool it in a freezer for several hours.

options.label: B
options.text: Hit it repeatedly with a hammer.

options.label: C
options.text: Put it in a coil carrying a direct current (d.c.).

options.label: D
